# STOP: check the base repository

This repository is a GitHub fork of `ken107/read-aloud`. GitHub defaults a
fork's pull request base to the PARENT repository. Before you create this PR,
confirm the base is:

    base repository: proctorio/herald    base: main

If the base says `ken107/read-aloud`, change it now. Do not send changes
upstream by accident.

Note: this GitHub repository is a read-only mirror published from an
internal repository. Pull requests opened here will be closed and
redirected.
